ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows an open mouth schematic. In the center below the oral cavity there is a large pink muscle-like structure, labeled D; it is located above the bottom of the oral cavity and below the upper soft palate/uvula region. Reasoning: The question asks about the organ responsible for taste and able to move food during chewing. This function and the position shown by D in the diagram both correspond to the tongue. Therefore the answer is tongue.
